36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
56237: The main character of the series and one of only 7 Campione.
56239: A member of 'Copper Black Cross' - a magician organization based in Milan. Holding the rank of Great Knight and the title of Diavolo Rosso she is a magic swordsmen that through coincidence meets Godou and assists him while he is in Sardinia.
56241: A part of the Japanese Magician's Society (History Compilation Committee) in an elite group known as the Hime-Miko. A miko with a strong Spirit Vision which allows her to obtain visions from objects.
56243: A member of "Bronze Black Cross," a magician organization based in Milan. Known as Erica's rival, she also holds the rank of Great Knight. Wielding her sword Il Maestro, her swordsmanship is on par with Erica; however, her true strength lies in Witchcraft.
56245: Ena has a very strange personality in that she seems relaxed about things of the modern world, but still has a slight naivite about her. She the type of person who acts on impulse and instinct, rather than her wits. Also a Hime-Miko like Yuri.
64613: The goddess of wisdom in Greek Mythology and the daughter of Zeus. She is in fact a snake deity associated with Medusa and an Earth and Death Goddess.
64615: He is a member of the Committee for the Compilation of True History and he is also Yuri's guardian.
64617: Godou's little sister, who is in her 3rd year of middle school. Also a member of the Tea Ceremony Club along with Yuri. Worried that her brother is becoming like their grandfather (a natural player), she is very strict with him to try prevent this.
65881: Verethragna is a battle-loving god and is willing to do anything to find a worthy opponent. He even went as far as to revive Melqart just so that he could fight him. He further gave one of his incarnation to Godou to test him and strengthen his opposition.
67153: Formerly known as a failure of a Knight Templar, which requires one to know an adequate amount of magic and swordsman ship. Salvatore Doni has zero knowledge in magic or magic related knowledge even after he became the 6th Campione. He is known as “the strongest knight of Italy”.
67161: Sasha Dejanstahl Voban is a Campione. He is very cold man who cares nothing for others, only desiring to battle worthy opponents (such as Heretic Gods) and gaining more Authorities. He is willing to kill anyone who gets in his way.
68189: Hikari Miariya is the younger sister of Yuri Mariya, and a Hime-Miko.
68375: Perseus is a Legendary Dragon Killer, a rouge god, the hero Perseus. He kills any dragons that he can find, not caring what the after math would be from destroying a dragon. According to him, slaying dragons is his duty. He rides on Pegasus. He uses a sword and a bow and arrow.
68443: Being Erica's maid, Arianna is very skilled in just about all forms of house-keeping and serving, though she is horrible at making soups or stews. She has also shown herself to be a terrible or reckless driver.
68445: Lucretia appears to be a playful sort, given to pranks of various kinds, though she appears willing to help people out when needed. She calls herself Godou's 'foreign wife,' but that appears more to be a joke than any actual romantic interest in Godou.
68813: Karen has a similar devilish personality as Erica Blandelli as well as being a very intelligent young lady.
68815: A goddess with pink hair tied in twintails and wears a white dress. She appears occasionally in Godou's dreams when he is in the border of life and death after the Ram Authority has been activated.
68817: A Heretic God of wind and thunder that Godou encountered during his trip to Italy in his spring break. He was awakened by Verethragna in order to be defeated. He teamed up temporarily with Godou, who is using the Tome of Prometheus, to defeat the Persian warlord.
71111: Metis is the mother and second personality of Athena.
71919: Susanoo is a former Heretic God. He seems rather mellow, as he even allows Ena to get away with calling him Grampsy, and asking Godou to call him Old Man. Still will not allow those who are not at least Campione, if not gods, to be in his presence.
75244: Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi (Sword of the Gathering Clouds of Heaven), also known as Kusanagi no Tsurugi (Grass-Cutting Sword), is a legendary black Japanese sword, and part of the Imperial Regalia of Japan.
